summary_en: Board authorized acquisition of up to 300,000 shares (1.86% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥2.0 billion through on-market purchases from December 1, 2026 through November 30, 2027. Concurrently, the company will cancel 675,000 shares (3.96% of pre-cancellation outstanding shares) on December 4, 2026.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Space Shower Skiyaki Holdings announced a new treasury stock acquisition program authorizing the company to repurchase up to 300,000 shares for a maximum of 2.0 billion yen through on-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from December 1, 2026 to November 30, 2027. This represents 1.9% of the company's 16,162,954 outstanding shares (net of treasury stock) as of October 31, 2026. The repurchase authorization follows the completion of a prior program on November 6, 2026. No price ceiling was specified.

The company stated that the treasury stock acquisition is intended to provide shareholders with enhanced profit returns while comprehensively considering the company's financial position and stock price levels, consistent with its medium-term management plan announced on November 13, 2024.

Concurrently, the board authorized the cancellation of 675,000 shares on December 4, 2026, representing 3.96% of pre-cancellation outstanding shares. The company noted that cancellation of previously acquired treasury stock clarifies that acquisitions are undertaken for shareholder return purposes and supports improvement in capital efficiency.
